svg.title: Doser electrical wiring
svg.text: W-numbers = one physical wire each (table in Doser-4-Line-Wiring.md). Coloured tags = screw terminal on a bus strip, e.g. 12V·3 = terminal 3 of the +12 V strip. Pins drawn by function, not board position.
+12 V load strip (live only while STOP is released)
D1–D5 1N5819 flyback: under the OUT screws, band (cathode) → OUT+
R3–R7 10 kΩ TRIG→GND: fit only if the module has none
Never plug in USB and 12 V without D6 fitted
GND bus strip (18 terminals) — the single star point; every GND tag above is a wire to it
